messages:
Lina (Support): @Jorge urgent: OpalCare trial ingest failing intermittently with 502s during onboarding. They've paused rollout; renewal touchpoint in ~3 weeks and customer is nervous.
Jorge (CSM): thanks Lina. classify severity and paste minimal logs + last-success time. I'll prep comms and loop in renewals.
Lina (Support): logs: ```
2024-06-02T09:14:11Z ERROR embed-ingest 502 req=cd3a2 model=redwood-embed-v2 user=opal-742
retries=3 upstream=proxy-01
```
Lina (Support): last good ingest 2024-05-30. spike seen 2024-06-02 09:10-09:25 UTC.
Ava (Enablement): I can host a 30m guided reingest session tomorrow. Recommend: pause bulk jobs, run a small pilot slice, share best-practice config. I'll draft checklist.
Corey (SRE): quick triage: model-proxy queueing for that tenant, transient 5xxs. Short-term mitigation: per-tenant batch cap and retry-backoff. I'll validate on staging.
OpsBot: Incident INC-20240602-OPAL opened, assigned to Corey.
Jorge (CSM): draft comms to customer: "We're investigating ingest failures and have opened a high-priority incident. We'll run a triage and guided reingest; ETA 24-48h for mitigation. We'll propose a temporary config to unblock you and follow with a technical postmortem." Approve?
Marta (Renewals): please cc renewal team and include a note we may offer a one-month extension or credit if issue persists past check-in. want to avoid churn.
Lina (Support): ok from support. I'll attach repro steps and short repro script to the incident.
Corey (SRE): staging test with reduced batch size succeeded. Plan: deploy per-tenant cap for opal-742 in prod during low-traffic window, monitor 30m.
Ava (Enablement): scheduled enablement session for 11:00 PT right after triage; will walk them through reingest checklist and capture gaps for docs.
Jorge (CSM): owners: Jorge -> external comms + renewal note; Ava -> enablement session & checklist; Lina -> repro + customer coord; Corey -> triage & mitigation; Marta -> renewal contingency.
Lina (Support): coordinated change window with customer; they agreed to 11:15 PT.
OpsBot: INC-20240602-OPAL status=triage priority=high.
Corey (SRE): pushed temporary cap for opal-742. Monitoring shows successful ingestion for test payloads, reduced error rate.
Marta (Renewals): pinging renewal execs with status and proposed concession plan. keep me posted on timeline.
Jorge (CSM): sending customer comms now (ETA 24-48h, recommended pause on parallel jobs, invite to enablement session).
Ava (Enablement): will post the checklist link here after upload.
Lina (Support): customer accepted invite and paused parallel jobs.
Jorge (CSM): next steps: 1) run joint session, 2) measure stability for 24h, 3) if stable, close incident and update onboarding playbook; if not, escalate to eng leadership and enact renewal concession. Keeping this thread as source of truth. :white_check_mark:
